title: Image Catalog
description: Single source of truth for the placeholder images rendered by <ImageTextSplit> on the service pages. Marketing drops the {webp,png,svg} triplet at public/images/hubs/{category}/{filename}.*; the build picks it up automatically. Renaming a filename or category requires updating the consuming page <ImageTextSplit catalogId> calls.

version.description: Catalog contract version. Bump the minor when a field is added, major when a field is removed or renamed.

lastUpdated.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last content edit to this catalog.

owner.description: Team accountable for keeping the catalog and the on-disk assets in sync.

notes.description: Free-form operational notes for whoever edits this file next.

id.description: Unique catalog key consumed as <ImageTextSplit catalogId="...">. Convention: {category}.{filename}.

page.description: Page that owns this image. Must be a trailing-slash URL (project rule: astro.config.mjs sets trailingSlash 'always').

pageName.description: Human-readable label for the page, shown on the dev-only /image-catalog/ status page.

filename.description: File basename under public/images/hubs/{category}/, without extension.

png.description: First onerror fallback. Must resolve to public/images/hubs/{category}/{filename}.png.

svg.description: Second onerror fallback. Must resolve to public/images/hubs/{category}/{filename}.svg.

alt.description: Accessible description of the finished image. Not a prompt.

prompt.description: Generation brief for the image producer.

decisionDim.description: Buyer Search Intelligence decision dimension this page answers (see .clinerules Buyer-Search-Intelligence-SOP).

status.description: 'placeholder' means marketing has not dropped the asset yet; 'real' means the triplet is on disk and checks/image-catalog.mjs should fail the build if it is not.

priority.description: Production order for the image backlog.

width.description: Intrinsic width in px. Emitted as the attribute to reserve aspect-ratio space before download (CLS).

height.description: Intrinsic height in px. Emitted as the attribute (CLS).
